# netbox_console_server_port (Resource)

Manages a NetBox console server port (`/api/dcim/console-server-ports/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_console_server_port" "example" {
  device_id = netbox_device.example.id
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the Device (`netbox_device`).
- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `label` (String) Physical label. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `mark_connected` (Boolean) Treat as if a cable is connected. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `module_id` (Number) ID of the Module (`netbox_module`).
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `speed` (Number) Port speed in bits per second. Valid values: `1200`, `2400`, `4800`, `9600`, `19200`, `38400`, `57600`, `115200`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `type` (String) Physical port type. Valid values: `de-9`, `db-25`, `rj-11`, `rj-12`, `rj-45`, `mini-din-8`, `usb-a`, `usb-b`, `usb-c`, `usb-mini-a`, `usb-mini-b`, `usb-micro-a`, `usb-micro-b`, `usb-micro-ab`, `other`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_console_server_port can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_console_server_port.example 123
```
